rationale: Round-3 duty (minimal confirm of the 8-file diff 0783a507..a8ac1fc4 against the AC-map basis): CONFIRMED. (1) No AC-pinning test is removed, renamed, or weakened. The only test file touched is internal/complete/materialize_attestation_test.go, and its delta is additive-or-retargeting only: TestStageAttestationSeamDefaults is RETARGETED from pointer-pinning bead.MergeMetadata/bead.GetMetadata to pinning the new named wrappers mergeMetadataEscaped/getMetadataEscaped (a strictly stronger pin: it now also forbids the family-wide escape silently dropping back to the raw bead functions), and TestMetadataSeamEscapedDefaults_RealChainHostileStderr is NEW. A corrected 57-name existence sweep of every test I located in rounds 1 and 2 (AC-1 through AC-16 incl. AC-4b/AC-10b, every lettered leg of AC-5/AC-7(i)/AC-8/AC-9/AC-10/AC-15/AC-16, the five TestDiscriminator_* legs, leg xxiv) finds 0 missing at a8ac1fc4; spec.md is not in this diff (last touched at the approval commit 1e41c7ce), so no renumbering is possible. (2) The one AC-relevant behaviour this commit adds IS pinned. complete.go swaps the two metadata seam defaults (completeMergeMetadataFn/completeGetMetadataFn) to named escaped wrappers routing bd errors through next.RenderBDError — an extension of AC-11's rendering leg to the metadata family. Its pin, TestMetadataSeamEscapedDefaults_RealChainHostileStderr, is a real-chain test (PATH-fronted fake bd failing with ANSI + CR + a forged standalone `recovery:` line, through the REAL bead.GetMetadata/bead.MergeMetadata chain) asserting diagnostic text preserved, no raw control byte, no standalone forged recovery line, and errors.As reaching *exec.ExitError through the wrapper — so bead.IsUnsupportedFlagError (which is errors.As-based, internal/bead/bdcli.go:115) is unaffected; PASS at tip. I additionally checked the composition risk this change creates that the diff's own tests do not: two sinks (materialize.go:160, complete.go:1391) still call next.RenderBDError on an error the seam has ALREADY rendered. A scratch test (written under internal/next for the run, removed, worktree verified byte-identical) proves RenderBDError is idempotent — termsafe.Escape is identity on printable text (termsafe.go:37) and an already-quoted recovery line no longer carries the bare `recovery:` prefix, so the second pass is a no-op: once == twice byte-for-byte on a hostile fixture. No double-quoting regression in any AC-11 render surface. (3) Every other file is comment/doc-only: materialize.go's three hunks are entirely inside doc comments (the two-crash-window enumeration and the honest-trust-boundary statement; the code paths they describe — attested resumes, mismatched/unattested ⇒ FOREIGN clear, read-failure propagates — remain pinned by the five TestDiscriminator_* legs, all PASS); repair.go and approve/plan.go replace stale line-number cites with function anchors; ADR-0041 and architecture.md (bead-7 → bead-2 attribution for advancePhaseOnClaim) are prose. (4) AC-2's doc cross-pin survives the lifecycle-modes.md edit: the delta is the prose paragraph describing the forced-backward row's two pre-use setup guards — a claim I verified TRUE against internal/phase/agreement_table_test.go:849-854 (DerivePhaseFromChildren(children) must equal the record's derivation; IsBackwardMove(preStored, freshDerived) must hold) — and no table cell changed; TestAgreementTable_Rows (13 rows) + TestAgreementTable_DocRowsCrossPinFixtures PASS at tip. (5) Basis re-run at a8ac1fc4: full internal/complete -short package ok (52s); targeted internal/complete legs for AC-4b, AC-6 (leg xxiii), AC-7(i) (leg xi), leg xxiv, all five discriminator legs, both seam pins — 16/16 PASS; cmd/mindspec -short pins for AC-1/AC-3/AC-4/AC-5(ii,iii,v,viii)/AC-12/AC-14/AC-16 tail — 37/37 PASS. My three round-1 no-change-required notes stand unchanged (BRIEF map filename imprecisions; leg xi's missing in-file AC-7 label; gate.go wording-only edit) and none is touched by this commit.

Verified empirically (scratch test, removed; checkout byte-identical) that RenderBDError(RenderBDError(e)).Error() == RenderBDError(e).Error() on a hostile fixture containing ANSI, CR, and a forged recovery line — termsafe.Escape is identity on printable text and the quoted recovery line no longer matches the bare prefix. No double-quoting in any AC-11 render surface.
